cause: The frozen C0 legacy compilation authority cutover completed its package-local implementation, focused tests, adversarial probes and formal verification.

Package-local acceptance is complete; downstream host and product integration remain separate gates.

cause: Independent adversarial review confirmed that the package-local legacy authority retirement is fail-closed, but Compiler-5 still constructs and calls the retired issuer.

lesson: Retiring a local authority must be integrated with every production caller before claiming the compile path is available; compatibility re-exports must be removed or remain typed rejection-only.
